description: Read-only XRPL DEX order-book lookup for a specific trading pair. `taker_gets` and `taker_pays` are the required XRPL currency-specification objects that define the two sides of the book; `limit` optionally caps the number of offers returned. The result provides global book offers and market-depth data without modifying the ledger, and calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for global DEX order-book depth; use n9t2_xrpl_list_account_offers for one account's outstanding offers and n9t2_xrpl_find_path when you need payment-path discovery instead.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of DEX order-book offers to return.
limit.title: Limit

taker_gets.description: Currency specification for the asset the taker receives in the XRPL DEX order book.
taker_gets.title: Taker Gets

taker_pays.description: Currency specification for the asset the taker pays in the XRPL DEX order book.
taker_pays.title: Taker Pays

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_book_offers
